source_fields.query_signature: Choose an arm $x_t$ and then observe all $m$ reward coordinates. Conditional on the past and current arm, each coordinate is $1$-sub-Gaussian around its fixed mean; coordinates need not be independent. $$\mathbb E\!\left[e^{s(Y_{t,i}-\mu_i(x_t))}\mid\mathcal H_{t-1},x_t\right]\le e^{s^2/2}\qquad(s\in\mathbb R,\ 1\le i\le m).$$ Causal randomized policies are allowed. Inputs $K,m,T,\delta_{\mathrm{conf}}$ and a tradeoff bound satisfying $\lambda\ge\lambda_\star$ are public. Mean vectors and the set of primary-objective optimal arms are hidden. Observed feedback may be stored and reused computationally; no unrevealed past information or additional queries to exhausted samples are available. Any within-round full-function or common-sample access must be explicit.

target_object_registry.definition: The finite action set has $K$ arms with a discrete metric of diameter at most $1$. Each arm has $m$ fixed mean rewards $\mu_1,\ldots,\mu_m$, ordered by priority, and each mean function is $1$-Lipschitz. Each objective has oscillation at most $1$; irrelevant common additive shifts are unrestricted. A lexicographically optimal arm $x^\star$ exists. Ties are allowed: each lower-priority objective is compared among arms optimal for all higher priorities. The tradeoff coefficient must be finite: $$\lambda_\star=\inf\!\left\{\lambda\ge0:\ \mu_i(x)-\mu_i(x^\star)\le\lambda\max_{j<i}\bigl(\mu_j(x^\star)-\mu_j(x)\bigr),\ \forall x\in\mathcal X,\ 2\le i\le m\right\}<\infty.$$

source_fields.query_signature: At round t, choose one arm $X_t\in\mathcal X$ using past observations and independent internal randomness, then receive both coordinates $(Y_t^1,Y_t^2)$. Conditional on the past and current arm, $\mathbb E[\exp(\theta(Y_t^i-\mu^i(X_t)))\mid\mathcal H_{t-1},X_t]\le\exp(\theta^2/2)$ for all real theta and i=1,2. Cross-coordinate independence is not required. No unselected-arm feedback, same-round second pull, or historical requery is provided. Public inputs are K,T, the fact m=2, and the finite supplied upper bound lambda. No external confidence parameter is required by this expected-regret view. Mean functions, the primary-optimal arm set, and the lexicographic optimum are hidden.

response_signature.feedback: The two reward coordinates of the selected arm only.
response_signature.noise: Each coordinate is conditionally 1-sub-Gaussian about its fixed mean; no cross-coordinate independence is assumed.
response_signature.queries: Exactly one selected-arm reward-vector query per round.

definition.arms: K finite arms with discrete metric; each objective mean is 1-Lipschitz under a diameter<=1 metric
definition.objectives: m ordered objectives with a lexicographically optimal arm x_star (ties allowed)
definition.tradeoff: lambda_star=inf{lambda>=0: mu_i(x)-mu_i(x_star)<=lambda max_{j<i}[mu_j(x_star)-mu_j(x)] for all i>=2,x}; restrict to finite lambda_star
